title: First Look at iPhone Air 2 and iPhone 18 Revealed By Dummy Models
content:
New images of dummy models offer an early look at the purported designs of the iPhone Air 2 and iPhone 18, showing a new dual rear camera arrangement for the Air and a largely unchanged appearance for the standard model.


In a new post on X, leaker Sonny Dickson highlights the ‌iPhone Air‌'s move from one rear camera to two as the biggest change. The standard ‌iPhone 18‌, he says, retains a design similar to the iPhone 17. A second image shows the fronts of the mockups.

The ‌iPhone Air‌ 2 mockup places both lenses horizontally toward the left side of its raised camera plateau, with the microphone and flash to their right. The plateau continues to stretch across most of the device's width. By comparison, the standard ‌iPhone 18‌ dummy has two vertically stacked lenses within a smaller, pill-shaped camera bump.

First look at the iPhone 18 Air and iPhone 18 dummy units. The biggest change is the iPhone 18 Air, which now features two rear cameras instead of one, while the standard iPhone 18 retains a design similar to the iPhone 17. pic.twitter.com/MdOVuwPlm3

— Sonny Dickson (@SonnyDickson) November 20, 2026



Dummy models are nonfunctional replicas typically produced using leaked dimensions and design information from Apple's supply chain. Accessory manufacturers use them to develop and test cases before the actual devices are available, allowing products to be ready around launch. This preparation makes dummy models a recurring source of early design previews, particularly for camera layouts, button placement, and overall proportions.

The second rear camera has been a consistent ‌iPhone Air‌ 2 rumor for more than a year. The Information reported in November 2025 that Apple was considering the addition as part of a redesign, with subsequent reports continuing to point to a dual-camera system.

The first-generation ‌iPhone Air‌ has a single 48-megapixel Fusion camera. Analyst Jeff Pu later predicted that its successor would gain a 48-megapixel Ultra Wide camera, adding a wider field of view to the device's photography capabilities.

Beyond the additional camera, Pu expects the next ‌iPhone Air‌ to feature an A20 Pro chip, a slightly smaller Dynamic Island, Apple's C2 modem, and an N2 wireless networking chip, while retaining a 6.5-inch display and 12GB of RAM. The Information previously reported that Apple was working on a larger battery, reduced weight, and vapor chamber cooling for the second-generation model.

The standard ‌iPhone 18‌ is expected to adopt the A20 chip and C2 modem, and could also gain a smaller ‌Dynamic Island‌ like the iPhone 18 Pro. Ming-Chi Kuo expects 9GB of memory, up from the ‌iPhone 17‌'s 8GB, while Pu predicts 12GB.

Both devices are expected to launch around March 2027, alongside the iPhone 18e.
